source: Own measurement through `ale validate` for version 0.4 (version 0.3's moving tissue, hidden tips, knocked camera head, takeovers with the per-procedure gate, horizon 10 deg and fine-work 32 px/s, development material without 3D truth; plus a holder unit that deviates from its datasheet and critical actions in every kind of procedure; generator endosim-procedure/0.5): run validate-aef9c5ac on the tree of 2a055f5b, the pinned engine bfb7505 (0.1.1), the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh; solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle of the frame, latency and its unit's deviations in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) as the oracle episode, graded in the engine's separate verifier sandbox (the renderer as its own account, the controller behind the network filter) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps; rigs by tests/review/draw_rigs.py, salts and camera head changes by draw_v3.py, units by draw_v4.py): useful_view_fraction 0.8113542 (per procedure 0.8438 0.8000 0.8900 0.6987 0.7750 0.8213 0.7262 0.8562 0.8625 0.9087 0.8150 0.7388), probe pairs 183 of 512 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no takeover, 71 critical actions, no lens contact, no renderer or solver restart; the canary 10 of 10 markers within 0.81 px; 124 ms a frame; verify 1479 s. Host: the author's validate host, one NVIDIA RTX 3090 on driver 535.183.01 (below Omniverse RTX's R550 floor, hence the renderer's driver check off), an Intel i9-12900K, Docker 29.10.1 in rootless mode, which cannot set a CPU quota: the engine's --cpus 8 was dropped and every process started through docker exec was pinned to 8 CPUs by affinity (OCI execCPUAffinity) instead. Natively, on the same task code (the tree of 89c64157; RTX 6000 Ada, driver 570.195.03, outside the engine): 0.8111458, every critical action seen on at least 0.727 of its steps (the rule ends a procedure under 0.25); single procedures are a step or so apart, as different probe draws make them. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer; over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop gave 0.81104 to 0.81167 (version 0.3's sets; the reference is not taken over in any draw, its lens never within 37 mm of the tissue). full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.3's anchor was 0.811 (validate-13c4ab75), version 0.2's 0.876 (validate-7485b98b), version 0.1's 0.903. Status: tests/README.md section 7.
